parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Verify Signature and Envelope').first().json.data; return [{ json: { to: d.patient_email || '', send: Boolean(d.patient_email), subject: 'Your appointment request was approved', html: `

Appointment request approved

Your request with ${d.doctor_name || 'the clinic'} for ${d.start_time} was approved and is awaiting final confirmation.

Appointment ID: ${d.appointment_id}

` } }];

const d = $('Verify Signature and Envelope').first().json.data; return [{ json: { to: d.patient_email || '', send: Boolean(d.patient_email), subject: 'Your appointment was cancelled', html: `

Appointment cancelled

Your appointment with ${d.doctor_name || 'the clinic'} at ${d.start_time} has status: ${d.status}.

Appointment ID: ${d.appointment_id}

Contact the clinic if you would like to request another time.

` } }];

const d = $('Verify Signature and Envelope').first().json.data; return [{ json: { to: d.patient_email || '', send: Boolean(d.patient_email), subject: 'Your appointment time was updated', html: `

Appointment rescheduled

Doctor: ${d.doctor_name || 'Not supplied'}

Previous time: ${d.previous_start_time}

New time: ${d.new_start_time}

Appointment ID: ${d.appointment_id}

` } }];
